subject: Re: postfix making too many queries to LDAP
body:
Mike Kenny:
  While others here might be able to speak to the query mechanism, my own
  suggestion is to stop doing remote queries to LDAP. Just because it's
  possible, doesn't mean you should. I take dumps of the Windows AD (only
  the required attributes) on a two-hourly basis (during the day), and use
  that to generate hashed map files for the actual address resolution on
  each of the Postfix servers. Your own dump interval should probably
  represent the KPIs you might have in relation to account/mail account
  creation.
 
   Other than speeding up the query time by looking at the local maps,
  you're not annoying your LDAP administrators by constantly thrashing it
  (and the internal network) with lookups, spurious or not. Of course,
  there are probably performance trade-offs if your hash (or whatever)
  maps get too large
